$comment: Preferred image models per use case. Read this before choosing a model. Update it through the check-model-pricing skill. Prices are list prices at 1K, USD, not live: confirm with scripts/model_price.py before any bulk run.
policy: Use the cost-effective default for most generations. Use the premium option only when the default failed on this job or the user asks for it.
Pick by use case. A model that won on text fidelity has not been shown to be good at characters or illustration.
Start with 2-4 images, not ten. Two models on the same prompt beats ten tries on one.

evidence_sources.tech_graphics_benchmark: danielrosehill/Tech-Graphics-Benchmark, rounds of 2026-10-28; catalogue/ and panels/2026-10.json hold the longlist and prices; results/2026-11-04-agent-read.json is an agent read, not human annotation

use_cases.when: Tech diagrams and infographics where labels must be spelled exactly
use_cases.evidence: Informational round: Flare 5/5, Nano Banana 2.1 5/5, Ideogram V4.5 3/5, FLUX.3 Klein 2/5, Qwen-Image 3 0/5 (agent read)

use_cases.when: Turning a photo of a whiteboard into a clean diagram

alternative.note: Only when every label is listed in the prompt: 0/5 without them, exact on the boards tried with them

use_cases.evidence: Whiteboard round: Nano Banana 2.1 3/5, all others 0/5 (agent read)

use_cases.when: Banners, hero images, social cards, cartoons without exact text
use_cases.evidence: Banner round annotation is unfinished, so no ranking yet

use_cases.when: Keeping a character or object recognisable from a reference image, including photo to cartoon
use_cases.evidence: One test on 2026-11-05, 2 images per model: both kept the character and added the requested props. Klein came out softer and more textured, Nano Banana 2.1 flatter and closer to vector. Not a benchmark.
On 2026-11-05 FLUX.1 schnell and dev returned 512x512 through the gateway square preset and missed a specific prop (a kippah came out as a beanie or bobble hat) in most tries

use_cases.when: Cutting a subject out before reuse
use_cases.evidence: Clean cut-out of a furry plush on a green screen, 2026-11-05 (one image)
